model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block RetryRouter
      (port in in Snapshot)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
    (block EdgeRenderer
      (port req in Request)
      (port done out Request)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
      (level
        (block LiveMetrics
          (port evt in Snapshot)
          (port out out Snapshot)
          (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block Metrics
                (port evt in Receipt)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Index
                (port in in Command)
                (port out out Request)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (block RemoteSync
                (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
            (adjacent
              (block ShadowCatalog :type "Service"
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block RemoteParser
                (port emit out Request)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
              (block Mailer :type "Feature"
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (block Router
                (port done out Receipt)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
            (block BatchAuth
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block RemotePricing
                (port emit out Event)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Scheduler :type "Process"
                (port in in Snapshot)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Editor
                (port in in Receipt)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (block RemoteSession
                (port out out Request)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
        (block EdgeCache
          (port evt in Command)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block LocalMailer
                (port req in Snapshot)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Audit :type "Store"
                (port in in Event)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block RetryPlanner
                (port done out Snapshot)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))))
        (block Session
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
          (level
            (block EdgeSync
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block EdgeIndex
              (port req in Command)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))))
    (block EdgeLedger
      (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
  (level
    (block ShadowCache :type "Store"
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
    (block LocalIndex :type "Service"
      (port emit out Event)
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
    (block EdgeScheduler :type "Service"
      (port done out Receipt)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
    (block LiveFeed
      (port req in Receipt)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))))
